versos.grego: Ὁ δὲ Σαῦλος ἔτι ἐμπνέων ἀπειλῆς καὶ φόνου εἰς τοὺς μαθητὰς τοῦ Κυρίου, προσελθὼν τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ

controles.web: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest,
controles.kjv: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
controles.livre: E Saulo, ainda assoprando ameaças e mortes contra os discípulos do Senhor, foi ao chefe dos sacerdotes.

versos.grego: ᾐτήσατο παρ’ αὐτοῦ ἐπιστολὰς εἰς Δαμασκὸν πρὸς τὰς συναγωγάς, ὅπως ἐάν τινας εὕρῃ τῆς Ὁδοῦ ὄντας, ἄνδρας τε καὶ γυναῖκας, δεδεμένους ἀγάγῃ εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ.

controles.web: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E pediu-lhe cartas para Damasco, para as sinagogas, para que se achasse alguns deste caminho, tanto homens como mulheres, ele os trouxesse presos a Jerusalém.

versos.grego: Ἐν δὲ τῷ πορεύεσθαι ἐγένετο αὐτὸν ἐγγίζειν τῇ Δαμασκῷ, ἐξαίφνης τε αὐτὸν περιήστραψεν φῶς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ,

controles.web: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.
controles.kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
controles.livre: E indo, aconteceu que chegando perto de Damasco, repentinamente brilhou ao redor dele uma luz do céu.

versos.grego: καὶ πεσὼν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἤκουσεν φωνὴν λέγουσαν αὐτῷ Σαοὺλ Σαούλ, τί με διώκεις;

controles.web: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
controles.kjv: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
controles.livre: E caindo em terra, ouviu ma voz lhe dizendo: Saulo, Saulo, por que me persegues?

versos.grego: εἶπεν δέ Τίς εἶ, Κύριε; ὁ δέ Ἐγώ εἰμι Ἰησοῦς ὃν σὺ διώκεις·

controles.web: He said, “Who are you, Lord?”   The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
controles.kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
controles.livre: E ele disse: Quem és, Senhor?E ele disse  : Eu sou Jesus, a quem tu persegues.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ἀνάστηθι καὶ εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν πόλιν, καὶ λαληθήσεταί σοι ὅ τί σε δεῖ ποιεῖν.

controles.web: Butrise up, and enter into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”
controles.kjv: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
controles.livre: mas levanta-te  , e entra na cidade; e ali te será dito o que deves fazer.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἄνδρες οἱ συνοδεύοντες αὐτῷ εἱστήκεισαν ἐνεοί, ἀκούοντες μὲν τῆς φωνῆς, μηδένα δὲ θεωροῦντες.

controles.web: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
controles.kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
controles.livre: E os homens que viajavam com ele pararam emudecidos, ouvindo, de fato, a voz, porém não vendo ninguém.

versos.grego: ἠγέρθη δὲ Σαῦλος ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς, ἀνεῳγμένων δὲ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ οὐδὲν ἔβλεπεν· χειραγωγοῦντες δὲ αὐτὸν εἰσήγαγον εἰς Δαμασκόν.

controles.web: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
controles.kjv: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
controles.livre: E Saulo se levantou da terra e, tendo aberto seus olhos, não via ninguém; e sendo guiado pela mão, levaram-no a Damasco.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦν ἡμέρας τρεῖς μὴ βλέπων, καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγεν οὐδὲ ἔπιεν.

controles.web: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.
controles.kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
controles.livre: E ele estava três dias sem ver; e não comeu, nem bebeu.

versos.grego: Ἦν δέ τις μαθητὴς ἐν Δαμασκῷ ὀνόματι Ἀνανίας, καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν ὁράματι ὁ Κύριος Ἀνανία. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ἰδοὺ ἐγώ, Κύριε.

controles.web: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!”   He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”
controles.kjv: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
controles.livre: E havia em Damasco um certo discípulo, de nome Ananias; e disse-lhe o Senhor em visão: Ananias!E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui, Senhor!

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν Ἀναστὰς πορεύθητι ἐπὶ τὴν ῥύμην τὴν καλουμένην Εὐθεῖαν καὶ ζήτησον ἐν οἰκίᾳ Ἰούδα Σαῦλον ὀνόματι Ταρσέα· ἰδοὺ γὰρ προσεύχεται,

controles.web: The Lord said to him, “Arise, and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judahfor one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
controles.livre: E o Senhor lhe disse : Levanta-te, e vai a rua chamada Direita, e pergunta na casa de Judas por um chamado Saulo, de Tarso; porque que ele ora.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶδεν ἄνδρα Ἀνανίαν ὀνόματι εἰσελθόντα καὶ ἐπιθέντα αὐτῷ χεῖρας, ὅπως ἀναβλέψῃ.

controles.web: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in, and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
controles.kjv: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
controles.livre: E ele viu em visão que um homem, de nome Ananias, entrava, e sobre ele punha a mão, para que voltasse a ver.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ Ἀνανίας Κύριε, ἤκουσα ἀπὸ πολλῶν περὶ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς τούτου, ὅσα κακὰ τοῖς ἁγίοις σου ἐποίησεν ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ·

controles.web: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
controles.livre: E Ananias respondeu: Senhor, eu ouvi de muitos sobre este homem, quantos males ele tem feito aos teus santos em Jerusalém;

versos.grego: καὶ ὧδε ἔχει ἐξουσίαν παρὰ τῶν ἀρχιερέων δῆσαι πάντας τοὺς ἐπικαλουμένους τὸ ὄνομά σου.

controles.web: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
controles.kjv: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
controles.livre: E aqui ele tem poder dos chefes dos sacerdotes para prender a todos os que invocam o teu nome.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Κύριος Πορεύου, ὅτι σκεῦος ἐκλογῆς ἐστίν μοι οὗτος τοῦ βαστάσαι τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐνώπιον ἐθνῶν τε καὶ βασιλέων υἱῶν τε Ἰσραήλ·

controles.web: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
controles.livre: Mas o Senhor lhe disse: Vai, porque este me é um vaso escolhido para levar meu nome diante dos gentios, e dos reis, e dos filhos de Israel;

versos.grego: ἐγὼ γὰρ ὑποδείξω αὐτῷ ὅσα δεῖ αὐτὸν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματός μου παθεῖν.

controles.web: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
controles.kjv: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake.
controles.livre: Porque eu mostrarei a ele o quanto ele deve sofrer por causa do meu nome.

versos.grego: Ἀπῆλθεν δὲ Ἀνανίας καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν, καὶ ἐπιθεὶς ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας εἶπεν Σαοὺλ ἀδελφέ, ὁ Κύριος ἀπέσταλκέν με, Ἰησοῦς ὁ ὀφθείς σοι ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ᾗ ἤρχου, ὅπως ἀναβλέψῃς καὶ πλησθῇς Πνεύματος Ἁγίου.

controles.web: Ananias departed, and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me, that you may receive your sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
controles.kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
controles.livre: E Ananias foi, e entrou na casa; e pondo as mãos sobre ele, disse: Irmão Saulo, o Senhor, que é Jesus, aquele que apareceu a ti no caminho, me enviou para que tu voltes a ver, e sejas cheio do Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθέως ἀπέπεσαν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ὡς λεπίδες, ἀνέβλεψέν τε, καὶ ἀναστὰς ἐβαπτίσθη,

controles.web: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.
controles.kjv: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
controles.livre: E logo lhe caíram como que escamas dos olhos, e imediatamente voltou a ver; e levantando-se, foi batizado.

versos.grego: καὶ λαβὼν τροφὴν ἐνίσχυσεν. Ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τῶν ἐν Δαμασκῷ μαθητῶν ἡμέρας τινὰς,

controles.web: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
controles.kjv: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
controles.livre: E ao comer, ele se fortaleceu. E Saulo ficou alguns dias com os discípulos que estavam em Damasco.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθέως ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς ἐκήρυσσεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν, ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
controles.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
controles.livre: E logo nas sinagogas pregava a Cristo, dizendo que aquele era o Filho de Deus.

versos.grego: ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες οἱ ἀκούοντες καὶ ἔλεγον Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ πορθήσας εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ τοὺς ἐπικαλουμένους τὸ ὄνομα τοῦτο, καὶ ὧδε εἰς τοῦτο ἐληλύθει, ἵνα δεδεμένους αὐτοὺς ἀγάγῃ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς;

controles.web: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”
controles.kjv: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
controles.livre: E todos os que o ouviam ficavam admirados, e diziam: Não é este aquele que em Jerusalém tentava destruir aos que invocavam este nome? E não foi para isso que ele veio aqui, para os levar presos aos chefes dos sacerdotes?

versos.grego: Σαῦλος δὲ μᾶλλον ἐνεδυναμοῦτο καὶ συνέχυννεν Ἰουδαίους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Δαμασκῷ, συμβιβάζων ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός.

controles.web: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
controles.kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
controles.livre: Mas Saulo se esforçava muito mais, e confundia aos judeus que habitavam em Damasco, provando que aquele era o Cristo.

versos.grego: Ὡς δὲ ἐπληροῦντο ἡμέραι ἱκαναί, συνεβουλεύσαντο οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀνελεῖν αὐτόν·

controles.web: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,
controles.kjv: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
controles.livre: E passados vários dias, os judeus tiveram conselho entre si para o matarem.

versos.grego: ἐγνώσθη δὲ τῷ Σαύλῳ ἡ ἐπιβουλὴ αὐτῶν. παρετηροῦντο δὲ καὶ τὰς πύλας ἡμέρας τε καὶ νυκτὸς ὅπως αὐτὸν ἀνέλωσιν·

controles.web: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,
controles.kjv: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
controles.livre: Mas as ciladas deles foram conhecidas por Saulo; e eles vigiavam as portas, tanto de dia como de noite, para poderem matá-lo.

versos.grego: λαβόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς διὰ τοῦ τείχους καθῆκαν αὐτὸν χαλάσαντες ἐν σπυρίδι.

controles.web: but his disciples took him by night, and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
controles.kjv: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
controles.livre: Porém os discípulos, tomando-o de noite, levaram-no abaixo pelo muro em um cesto.

versos.grego: Παραγενόμενος δὲ εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἐπείραζεν κολλᾶσθαι τοῖς μαθηταῖς· καὶ πάντες ἐφοβοῦντο αὐτόν, μὴ πιστεύοντες ὅτι ἐστὶν μαθητής.

controles.web: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
controles.kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
controles.livre: E Saulo, tendo vindo a Jerusalém, procurava se juntar aos discípulos; mas todos tinham medo dele, não crendo que fosse discípulo.

versos.grego: Βαρνάβας δὲ ἐπιλαβόμενος αὐτὸν ἤγαγεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστόλους, καὶ διηγήσατο αὐτοῖς πῶς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ εἶδεν τὸν Κύριον καὶ ὅτι ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ, καὶ πῶς ἐν Δαμασκῷ ἐπαρρησιάσατο ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
controles.kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
controles.livre: Mas Barnabás, tomando-o consigo, trouxe -o aos apóstolos, e contou-lhes como no caminho tinha visto ao Senhor, e tinha lhe falado, e como em Damasco tinha falado ousadamente no nome de Jesus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦν μετ’ αὐτῶν εἰσπορευόμενος καὶ ἐκπορευόμενος εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ, παρρησιαζόμενος ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου,

controles.web: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,
controles.kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E ele estava junto deles, entrando e saindo em Jerusalém;

versos.grego: ἐλάλει τε καὶ συνεζήτει πρὸς τοὺς Ἑλληνιστάς· οἱ δὲ ἐπεχείρουν ἀνελεῖν αὐτόν.

controles.web: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.
controles.kjv: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
controles.livre: E falando ousadamente no nome do Senhor;  falava e discutia também contra os gregos; mas eles procuravam matá-lo.

versos.grego: ἐπιγνόντες δὲ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ κατήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς Καισάριαν καὶ ἐξαπέστειλαν αὐτὸν εἰς Ταρσόν.

controles.web: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him off to Tarsus.
controles.kjv: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Cesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
controles.livre: E os irmãos, ao perceberem isto , o levaram até Cesareia, e o enviaram a Tarso.

versos.grego: Ἡ μὲν οὖν ἐκκλησία καθ’ ὅλης τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ Γαλιλαίας καὶ Σαμαρίας εἶχεν εἰρήνην οἰκοδομουμένη καὶ πορευομένη τῷ φόβῳ τοῦ Κυρίου, καὶ τῇ παρακλήσει τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος ἐπληθύνετο.

controles.web: So the assemblies throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.
controles.kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
controles.livre: Então as igrejas por toda a Judeia, e Galileia, e Samaria, tinham paz, e eram edificadas; e andando no temor do Senhor, e na consolação do Espírito Santo, se multiplicavam.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ Πέτρον διερχόμενον διὰ πάντων κατελθεῖν καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἁγίους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Λύδδα.

controles.web: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, Pedro, passando por todos os lugares , veio também aos santos que habitavam em Lida.

versos.grego: εὗρεν δὲ ἐκεῖ ἄνθρωπόν τινα ὀνόματι Αἰνέαν ἐξ ἐτῶν ὀκτὼ κατακείμενον ἐπὶ κραβάττου, ὃς ἦν παραλελυμένος.

controles.web: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.
controles.kjv: And there he found a certain man named Eneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
controles.livre: E ali ele achou a um certo homem chamado Enéas, que havia oito anos que jazia numa cama, que era paralítico.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος Αἰνέα, ἰᾶταί σε Ἰησοῦς Χριστός· ἀνάστηθι καὶ στρῶσον σεαυτῷ. καὶ εὐθέως ἀνέστη.

controles.web: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.
controles.kjv: And Peter said unto him, Eneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
controles.livre: E Pedro lhe disse: Enéas, Jesus Cristo te cura; levanta-te, e faz tua cama. E logo ele se levantou.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶδαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες Λύδδα καὶ τὸν Σαρῶνα, οἵτινες ἐπέστρεψαν ἐπὶ τὸν Κύριον.

controles.web: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
controles.kjv: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
controles.livre: E todos os que habitavam em Lida e Sarona o viram, os quais se converteram ao Senhor.

versos.grego: Ἐν Ἰόππῃ δέ τις ἦν μαθήτρια ὀνόματι Ταβειθά, ἣ διερμηνευομένη λέγεται Δορκάς· αὕτη ἦν πλήρης ἔργων ἀγαθῶν καὶ ἐλεημοσυνῶν ὧν ἐποίει.

controles.web: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated, means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.
controles.kjv: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
controles.livre: E havia em Jope uma certa discípula, de nome Tabita, que traduzido se diz Dorcas.  Esta estava cheia de boas obras e doações que ela fazia aos necessitados .

versos.grego: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἀσθενήσασαν αὐτὴν ἀποθανεῖν· λούσαντες δὲ ἔθηκαν ἐν ὑπερῴῳ.

controles.web: In those days, she fell sick, and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
controles.livre: E aconteceu naqueles dias, que tendo ela ficado doente, morreu; e tendo a lavado, puseram-na no compartimento superior.

versos.grego: ἐγγὺς δὲ οὔσης Λύδδας τῇ Ἰόππῃ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀκούσαντες ὅτι Πέτρος ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτῇ ἀπέστειλαν δύο ἄνδρας πρὸς αὐτὸν παρακαλοῦντες Μὴ ὀκνήσῃς διελθεῖν ἕως ἡμῶν.

controles.web: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
controles.kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
controles.livre: E como Lida era perto de Jope, os discípulos, ao ouvirem que Pedro estava ali, mandaram-lhe dois homens, rogando -lhe que não demorasse a vir a eles.

versos.grego: ἀναστὰς δὲ Πέτρος συνῆλθεν αὐτοῖς· ὃν παραγενόμενον ἀνήγαγον εἰς τὸ ὑπερῷον, καὶ παρέστησαν αὐτῷ πᾶσαι αἱ χῆραι κλαίουσαι καὶ ἐπιδεικνύμεναι χιτῶνας καὶ ἱμάτια, ὅσα ἐποίει μετ’ αὐτῶν οὖσα ἡ Δορκάς.

controles.web: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the coats and garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
controles.kjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
controles.livre: E Pedro, tendo se levantado, foi com eles; o qual chegou, e o levaram ao compartimento superior, e todas as viúvas o rodearam, chorando, e mostrando -lhe as túnicas e roupas que Dorcas tinha feito quando estava com elas.

versos.grego: ἐκβαλὼν δὲ ἔξω πάντας ὁ Πέτρος καὶ θεὶς τὰ γόνατα προσηύξατο, καὶ ἐπιστρέψας πρὸς τὸ σῶμα εἶπεν Ταβειθά, ἀνάστηθι. ἡ δὲ ἤνοιξεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῆς, καὶ ἰδοῦσα τὸν Πέτρον ἀνεκάθισεν.

controles.web: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
controles.kjv: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
controles.livre: Mas Pedro, pondo para fora a todas; pôs-se de joelhos, e orou; e virando-se para o corpo, disse: Tabita, levanta-te;E ela abriu seus olhos, e vendo a Pedro, sentou-se.

versos.grego: δοὺς δὲ αὐτῇ χεῖρα ἀνέστησεν αὐτήν· φωνήσας δὲ τοὺς ἁγίους καὶ τὰς χήρας παρέστησεν αὐτὴν ζῶσαν.

controles.web: He gave her his hand, and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
controles.kjv: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
controles.livre: E ele, dando-lhe a mão, levantou-a; e tendo chamado aos santos, e às viúvas, apresentou-a viva.

versos.grego: γνωστὸν δὲ ἐγένετο καθ’ ὅλης τῆς Ἰόππης, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν πολλοὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Κύριον.

controles.web: And it became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
controles.kjv: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
controles.livre: E isto ficou conhecido por toda Jope, e muitos creram no Senhor.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἡμέρας ἱκανὰς μεῖναι ἐν Ἰόππῃ παρά τινι Σίμωνι βυρσεῖ.

controles.web: He stayed many days in Joppa with one Simon, a tanner.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que ele ficou muitos dias em Jope, com um certo Simão curtidor.
